description: Re-publishing resets `published_at` (already recorded as deferred).
`name`, `message` and `phone` are uncapped (the reviewer noted this duplicates the length-cap finding).
Login status discrimination treats 429 rate limit errors as bad credentials rather than generic failures.
The hardcoded `/search` action can lose the locale prefix with JS off.
A plain GET form submits empty selects as `operation=&neighborhood=&property_type=`, but the spec says empty fields are omitted.
An auth-server outage during `getUser(token)` is reported as 401, so clients discard valid tokens.
Gallery has no arrow-key or swipe support and no image-load error handling.
Footer and nav link to /privacy, /terms, /search, /neighborhoods, /about, /contact and /login. None of these pages exist yet, so they 404, and the legal pages aren't in the spec at all.
`area_m2` with more than 2 decimals near the cap rounds past `numeric(10,2)`, so the DB error 22003 surfaces as a 500 instead of a 400.
A null or non-array `row.images` embed could throw in `orderImages` and blank the whole featured list.
`open_house_at` accepts non-ISO strings such as "1".
The success and error messages have no persistent aria-live region, so assistive tech may not announce them.
Position and ordering logic in upload, reorder and delete is untested, even with a stub client.
The 400 invalid-JSON body is not `{error:"Invalid JSON"}`.
Neighborhood options are a fixed footer subset, so listings in other neighborhoods can't be searched from the hero.
The claim that the switch keeps path and query is untrue for repeated keys, and the hash is dropped.
Inputs have no required or aria-required, and the aria-hidden "*" hides that fields are required from screen readers.
`getAgent` accepts any valid Supabase user with no agent-row check, so a non-agent gets inconsistent responses (403 on POST, empty list on GET, 404 on PATCH and DELETE).
The server ignores consent and stores no consent timestamp, double opt-in or unsubscribe mechanism.
Locale routing and the language switch are tested only against a hand-written mock, never the real next-intl output.
The global navigation mock ignores array queries and never exercises the real `createNavigation`.
Several cases are untested: empty-string `listing_id` or `phone`, email over 254 characters, array or primitive body at the route level, and wrong content-type.
No positive boundary tests for `limit=50` or `page=100000`.
Cross-agent isolation (agent B vs agent A's rows) is not recorded as verified.
Unused message keys: `errors.name.invalid`, `errors.message.invalid`, `errors.phone.required`, `errors.email.tooLong`.
Focus stays on the submit button after a failed validation, so the errors are not announced.
`LocaleLayout` itself is never rendered, so the `/fr` → 404 and `<html lang>` rows have no tests. The `pathname` close effect is also untested.
The "single request" double-submit guarantee has no same-tick guard, and the test submits only after re-render.
All tests mock the Supabase client, so RLS ownership enforcement is never verified, and `deferred-work.md` does not record this gap for S06.
No i18n parity test was extended for the new `Listing` namespace.
